title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, and implement backend systems and APIs using Java (Spring Boot/Spring Cloud) for AI-driven applications.
  • Collaborate with data science and ML teams to integrate machine learning models and pipelines into scalable backend services.
  • Develop and optimize microservices, ensuring low latency and high availability.
  • Implement data ingestion, transformation, and model-serving workflows in coordination with ML engineers.
  • Ensure seamless deployment of ML models through API endpoints and containerized environments.
  • Apply best practices for security, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems.
  • Optimize backend services for performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure as code.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (AI/ML specialization a plus).
  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience with Java.
  • Strong proficiency in Java (8 or higher) and frameworks such as Spring Boot or Spring Cloud .
  • Experience with RESTful API design , microservices architecture , and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
  • Proficient in Git , CI/CD pipelines , and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of Agile development principles and version control best practices.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and CI/CD for ML pipelines.
  • Contributions to AI/ML-related open-source projects or research experience.


Benefits

- Full-time remote working within an international environment

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Remote Government Sector Expert - 65106
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for public sector domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in government, policy, and social service domains


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world public sector and policy scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Social Work, Public Administration, Management, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession
  • Ability to convert work scenarios into structured, high-quality prompts


Who can Apply :

We are open to many experts within the public sector (including but not limited to): Child, Family, and School Social Workers, First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives, Recreation Workers, Compliance Officers, Administrative Services Managers.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: SAP MDK Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP MDK Consultant


Location: Remote

Experience: 4+ Years


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced SAP MDK Consultant with strong expertise in SAP Mobile Development Kit and SAP Asset Manager. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience developing and enhancing mobile applications, working with SAP BTP Mobile Services, and integrating with backend systems such as SAP S/4HANA.


Key Responsibilities


Develop, enhance, and maintain applications using SAP Mobile Development Kit.


Participate in SAP Asset Manager implementation projects, including full lifecycle delivery.


Enhance and extend standard functionality within SAP Asset Manager.


Create and debug MDK Branded Clients for Android and iOS platforms.


Configure and support the SAP Syclo Framework.


Perform troubleshooting using SAP Gateway tracing and error logs.


Develop and integrate applications using OData Services for mobile solutions.


Support upgrade activities related to SAP Asset Manager applications.


Ensure development follows architecture standards and best practices.


Manage and resolve MDK issues during Unit Testing and Integration Testing phases.


Maintain development SLAs and coordinate with cross-functional teams.


Required Skills


4+ years of experience in SAP Mobile Development Kit development.


Hands-on experience in SAP mobility solutions with at least one full lifecycle implementation in asset management mobility.


Experience deploying applications using SAP BTP Mobile Services.


Strong experience in SAP Asset Manager implementation and enhancements.


Expertise in OData services including online/offline synchronization.


Strong JavaScript skills for MDK rule development and customization.


Integration experience with SAP S/4HANA.


Knowledge of offline enablement, synchronization, security (OAuth/SAML), and performance optimization.


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of SAP ABAP debugging.


Experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) / Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) processes.


Exposure to legacy mobility platforms such as SAP Syclo.

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager

One of our fast-growing US clients is looking for a versatile SEO marketer with a strong Growth foundation and proven experience running B2B campaigns. In this role, you'll own the search strategy, drive measurable pipeline growth, and support high-impact marketing initiatives across the funnel.


You’ll spend about 60% of your time on SEO (including AI-driven SEO) and 40% on broader growth projects . From improving rankings on Google and LLMs to launching targeted ads on LinkedIn and Google, you’ll be responsible for identifying the biggest opportunities, creating a plan, and executing quickly.

  • Own and evolve the SEO strategy to improve rankings, visibility, and conversions across both Google search and large language models.

  • Write high-converting copy for ads, landing pages, and growth experiments.
  • Support awareness and demand-gen initiatives, including webinar promotion, content refreshes, and campaign execution.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to execute cross-functional growth projects.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in B2B environments.
  • Proven success in SEO, including technical SEO, content optimization, and AI-driven SEO strategies.
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads .
  • Proficiency with SEO tools such as SEMrush , Ahrefs , or equivalents.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:

Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos.
  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2; Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2; Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx).
  • Experiência sólida com Jenkins, incluindo: Criação e gerenciamento de pipelines; Integração com diversas ferramentas (ex: Git, SonarQube, testes automatizados); Configuração de agentes e escalabilidade do Jenkins; Administração do Jenkins e resolução de problemas.

  • Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.

  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: AI Developer/ 100% Remote in Brazil
description:

Job Description:


Role Summary

The AI Engineer – Integrations & Automation will design, build, and maintain AI‑driven automations and integrations that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of AI platforms, internal systems, and business workflows. This is a remote position.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. Objectives:

  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

title: Translator and Project Coordinator
description:
Translator & Project Coordinator


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


We are seeking a bilingual professional to join our Translations Department in a dual-capacity role. The ideal candidate will serve as an in-house Spanish-into-English OR Portuguese-into-English translator, handling daily document translation tasks, while also providing project management support, including covering a Project Manager during periods of absence and independently managing a few translation projects.


This position is well suited to someone who combines strong linguistic precision with organizational skills and a solid understanding of certified translation standards for immigration, legal, and official documentation.


Key Responsibilities:

-Translation (Primary Function)

  • Translate Spanish-language OR Portuguese-language documents into English on a daily basis, including birth certificates, marriage certificates, diplomas, academic transcripts, identification documents, legal contracts, and immigration records.
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and appropriate register across all document types.
  • Apply quality assurance procedures, including self-review and adherence to departmental style guides.
  • Assist with post-editing machine-translated content (MTPE) when applicable.


-Project Coordination (Secondary Function)

  • Act as the primary point of contact for project management duties when a Project Manager is out of office.
  • Manage translation projects from intake to delivery, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Coordinate with translators, reviewers, and external vendors; assign tasks and track progress.
  • Monitor project timelines, communicate status updates to clients, and flag potential delays proactively.


Requirements:

-Education & Language

  • Bachelor's degree in Translation, Linguistics, Spanish OR Portuguese, or a related field (required).
  • Near-native or native proficiency in Spanish OR Portuguese (required); native or near-native English proficiency (required).
  • Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, fluent certified translations for official use.


-Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of professional translation experience, specifically Spanish-to-English OR Portuguese-to-English.


-Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to translation accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication in English.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and PDF tools (e.g., Adobe Acrobat).


What We Offer:

  • A structured, professional environment within an established certified translation company.
  • Exposure to a wide variety of document types, languages, and complex translation challenges.
  • A clear dual-track career path combining linguistic expertise and project management.
  • Collaborative team culture with experienced PMs and senior translators.

title: Analista De Testes (IA) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista De Testes (IA) - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Responsável por garantir não apenas a funcionalidade, mas também a inteligência, a ética e a confiabilidade dos modelos de IA. Irá desenvolver e executar estratégias de teste específicas para sistemas de IA, validando desde a qualidade dos dados até a precisão e o comportamento dos agentes.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Automação de Testes: Experiência consolidada em automação de testes para aplicações em ambiente Cloud .
  • Testes de IA/ML: Conhecimento em técnicas de teste para sistemas de IA, como avaliação de métricas de modelos (precisão, recall), teste de robustez, detecção de vieses (bias) e validação de pipelines de dados.
  • Ferramentas de QA: Familiaridade com frameworks de automação de testes (ex: Selenium, Cypress, Maestro, Appium), ferramentas de teste de API (ex: Postman) e testes de performance (ex: JMeter, K6).
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimentos básicos em bancos de dados SQL.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de entender a arquitetura de sistemas de IA para planejar testes em todas as camadas (dados, modelo, API, UI).
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Habilidade para pensar criticamente sobre os possíveis pontos de falha em um sistema inteligente e criar cenários de teste que explorem esses limites.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.


If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.


We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.


The impact you'll make:


  • Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
  • Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
  • Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
  • Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence


Technology Stack:


  • Go (Golang)
  • Blockchain


What you'll bring to us:


  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
  • Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
  • Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
  • Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
  • Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
  • Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, EdDSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
  • Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro.



Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy working with us:


  • The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
  • The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A flexible and remote working environment.

This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

description:

﻿

Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,300 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Coordinator to support the execution of global paid digital marketing campaigns, partnering closely with recruiting teams to broaden reach, solidify awareness, and drive engagement among executive audiences. In this role, you will manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across platforms (primarily LinkedIn), with increasing responsibility for performance reporting, cross-team communication, and center-of-excellence (CoE) growth in this rapidly scaling function.


Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Execution & Project Management

  • You will partner with global marketing and recruiting teams to implement LinkedIn campaigns, with potential execution across Display, Demand Base, Google Ads, Meta as well.
  • You will manage campaign timelines, deliverables, and workflows using tools like Trello and Kapost.
  • You will own end-to-end campaign coordination: audience builds, creative trafficking, asset QA, go-live, and monitoring.
  • You will support the creative development process by coordinating asset needs and advising on what to run—drawing from historical performance, cross-regional learnings, and campaign objectives—to ensure assets are optimized and platform-ready.
  • You will manage campaign budgets, billing, and vendor invoicing.


Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • You will coordinate with marketing and recruiting team colleagues, ensuring alignment across stakeholder groups and campaign objectives.
  • You will provide regular status updates and post-campaign summaries to multiple stakeholder groups.
  • You will cultivate trusted working relationships across geographies with increasing ownership over time.
  • You will play an active role in teaching and training recruiting teams on digital best practices by building a scalable library of case studies, playbooks, and success stories to turn stakeholders into digital believers and promoters.


Reporting & Insights

  • You will support campaign reporting, tracking KPIs across platforms to assess performance and optimization opportunities.
  • You will assist in synthesizing data into practical insights using Excel and PowerPoint.
  • You will develop toward the ability to independently derive insights and communicate them effectively.


Learning & Development

  • You will build a working understanding of paid social strategy, audience segmentation, and platform capabilities (with a focus on LinkedIn).
  • You will engage in testing and learning initiatives to refine targeting and creative performance.
  • You will demonstrate curiosity and initiative to develop analytical skills and marketing fluency.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Digital campaign execution – ability to manage end-to-end paid media campaigns primarily on LinkedIn including creative trafficking, pacing and reporting
  • Cross-functional project management – strong organizational and time management skills to juggle high volume of campaigns, stakeholders and platforms
  • Analytics and reporting insights – ability to track and interpret digital performance metrics deriving actionable insights and interpreting to non-marketing audiences
  • Relationship management and strong communication – strong written and verbal communication skills to build trust with global stakeholders and building strong collaboration and desire for improvement


Principal Accountabilities and % of time

  • Execute and manage global paid digital campaigns across LinkedIn in support of recruiting audiences across the globe– 50%
  • Support campaign performance tracking, reporting and insights development – 20%
  • Stakeholder alignment and communication across geographies – 10%
  • Help build case libraries, templates and training resources to upskill internal teams – 5%
  • Support additional team priorities and special projects as needed – 15%


Experience:

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent digital campaigns, each with distinct goals, timelines, and stakeholder needs, all while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills; thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with minimal oversight.
  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership; eager to learn and grow in a rapidly evolving space.
  • Foundational experience with LinkedIn Ads; interest in expanding into platforms like Meta, Demandbase and Google Ads.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including sharp copywriting skills for social content.
  • Proficient in or quick to learn project and content management tools such as Trello and Kapost.
  • Ability to independently analyze campaign performance and optimize based on insights.
  • Experience developing campaign briefs or contributing to digital strategy.
  • Familiarity with multi-channel digital ecosystems and measurement approaches.
  • Proactive identification of opportunities to enhance campaign impact across markets.
  • Confidence in synthesizing and presenting insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience with Excel modeling and data visualization for executive reporting.
  • Strong ownership mindset with a drive to improve processes and results.
  • Collaborative and respectful teammate across global teams.
  • Demonstrates adaptability, resilience, and a learning mindset in ambiguous or evolving situations.


Education OR equivalent combination of education, training, and experience:

  • Education, training, and hands-on experience in digital marketing or campaign management with exposure to LinkedIn Ads or multi-channel campaign execution


Additional Requirements:

  • Flexibility to work across time zones, including regular communication with the team lead based in U.S. Central Standard Time (CST), and in close collaboration across global teams and stakeholders


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to manage global digital campaigns and grow within a fast-scaling marketing function.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Sales Manager para atuar junto a um de nossos clientes do setor de Fabricação de produtos químicos. Esta é a função responsável por atingir os objetivos de receita junto à equipe de vendas em nível global, atuando na gestão de equipes, análise de mercado e definição de planos comerciais e de clientes.

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Idioma: Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Duração: Indeterminado

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar um plano de vendas internacional e metas (quotas) alinhadas ao plano operacional anual.
  • Gerenciar o desempenho de colaboradores individuais e/ou equipes dedicadas.
  • Analisar ativamente as tendências do mercado global para enfrentar desafios de forma eficiente e aproveitar oportunidades.
  • Manter margens de preço para atingir as metas de rentabilidade.
  • Garantir o mix de produtos com base em receita, volume e margens.

  • Atingir metas de receita visando crescimento ideal ano a ano.
  • Monitorar o desempenho de pagamentos na carteira de clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos de aquisição e retenção de clientes para maximizar o valor do ciclo de vida do cliente (CLV).
  • Acompanhar a entrega de serviços técnicos dos produtos em toda a carteira de clientes.
  • Participar de programas de treinamento para equipes globais com base em análise de gaps de competências.
  • Realizar reportes periódicos de vendas e apresentações junto ao vice-presidente.
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas e proposição de ações em coordenação com o vice-presidente.
  • Trabalhar em outros projetos comerciais adicionais conforme designado.

Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente
  • Graduação em química, engenharia química ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência na indústria química.

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

  • Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
  • Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
  • Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
  • Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.


What we expect from you:


  • Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
  • Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
  • Previous experience with Workday is a plus.


Soft Skills

  • Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution.
  • Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
  • Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.


What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: CUA Trajectory Specialist - 65129
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for skilled professionals to contribute as S2 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating high-quality Computer-Use Agent (CUA) trajectories for developer-adjacent workflows. This includes tasks such as file operations, light scripting, API interactions, and browser automation.

This role requires a strong understanding of technical workflows, attention to detail, and the ability to translate natural language instructions into precise, step-by-step executable actions that can be used to train advanced AI systems.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create detailed, step-by-step positive CUA trajectories for technical tasks (e.g., file manipulation, scripting, API calls, browser-based workflows)
  • Break down natural language instructions into clear, verifiable actions
  • Validate and review trajectories for correctness, completeness, and reproducibility
  • Work within Linux desktop environments to execute and document workflows
  • Use scripting (Python/Bash) to simulate or validate task execution where required
  • Interact with tools and environments involving APIs, terminals, and browser automation
  • Collaborate with internal teams to refine task quality and annotation guidelines
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and high-quality standards across all annotations


Requirements:

  • 2–5 years of experience in software development, technical support, or similar technical roles
  • Strong familiarity with Linux environments and command-line operations
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python or Bash
  • Ability to decompose complex instructions into structured, step-by-step workflows
  • Strong attention to detail in documenting technical processes
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows
  • Basic understanding of APIs, file systems, and developer tooling
  • Familiarity with OpenClaw or similar environments/tools


Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in data annotation, RLHF, or SFT labeling workflows
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, or terminal-based automation
  • Experience working with browser automation tools or developer productivity tools
  • Background in evaluating or improving AI-generated outputs


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work with cutting-edge AI technology and contribute to next-generation systems
  • Flexible, remote work environment
  • Opportunity to collaborate with leading AI researchers and engineers
  • Competitive compensation based on your expertise
  • Long-term engagement opportunities


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Paid Media Coordinator - LinkedInAds
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,300 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Coordinator to support the execution of global paid digital marketing campaigns, partnering closely with recruiting teams to broaden reach, solidify awareness, and drive engagement among executive audiences. In this role, you will manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across platforms (primarily LinkedIn), with increasing responsibility for performance reporting, cross-team communication, and center-of-excellence (CoE) growth in this rapidly scaling function.


Key Responsibilities:

Campaign Execution & Project Management

  • You will partner with global marketing and recruiting teams to implement LinkedIn campaigns, with potential execution across Display, Demand Base, Google Ads, Meta as well.
  • You will manage campaign timelines, deliverables, and workflows using tools like Trello and Kapost.
  • You will own end-to-end campaign coordination: audience builds, creative trafficking, asset QA, go-live, and monitoring.
  • You will support the creative development process by coordinating asset needs and advising on what to run—drawing from historical performance, cross-regional learnings, and campaign objectives—to ensure assets are optimized and platform-ready.
  • You will manage campaign budgets, billing, and vendor invoicing.


Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • You will coordinate with marketing and recruiting team colleagues, ensuring alignment across stakeholder groups and campaign objectives.
  • You will provide regular status updates and post-campaign summaries to multiple stakeholder groups.
  • You will cultivate trusted working relationships across geographies with increasing ownership over time.
  • You will play an active role in teaching and training recruiting teams on digital best practices by building a scalable library of case studies, playbooks, and success stories to turn stakeholders into digital believers and promoters.


Reporting & Insights

  • You will support campaign reporting, tracking KPIs across platforms to assess performance and optimization opportunities.
  • You will assist in synthesizing data into practical insights using Excel and PowerPoint.
  • You will develop toward the ability to independently derive insights and communicate them effectively.


Learning & Development

  • You will build a working understanding of paid social strategy, audience segmentation, and platform capabilities (with a focus on LinkedIn).
  • You will engage in testing and learning initiatives to refine targeting and creative performance.
  • You will demonstrate curiosity and initiative to develop analytical skills and marketing fluency.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Digital campaign execution – ability to manage end-to-end paid media campaigns primarily on LinkedIn including creative trafficking, pacing and reporting
  • Cross-functional project management – strong organizational and time management skills to juggle high volume of campaigns, stakeholders and platforms
  • Analytics and reporting insights – ability to track and interpret digital performance metrics deriving actionable insights and interpreting to non-marketing audiences
  • Relationship management and strong communication – strong written and verbal communication skills to build trust with global stakeholders and building strong collaboration and desire for improvement


Principal Accountabilities and % of time

  • Execute and manage global paid digital campaigns across LinkedIn in support of recruiting audiences across the globe– 50%
  • Support campaign performance tracking, reporting and insights development – 20%
  • Stakeholder alignment and communication across geographies – 10%
  • Help build case libraries, templates and training resources to upskill internal teams – 5%
  • Support additional team priorities and special projects as needed – 15%


Experience:

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience.
  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent digital campaigns, each with distinct goals, timelines, and stakeholder needs, all while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills; thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with minimal oversight.
  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership; eager to learn and grow in a rapidly evolving space.
  • Foundational experience with LinkedIn Ads; interest in expanding into platforms like Meta, Demandbase and Google Ads.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including sharp copywriting skills for social content.
  • Proficient in or quick to learn project and content management tools such as Trello and Kapost.
  • Ability to independently analyze campaign performance and optimize based on insights.
  • Experience developing campaign briefs or contributing to digital strategy.
  • Familiarity with multi-channel digital ecosystems and measurement approaches.
  • Proactive identification of opportunities to enhance campaign impact across markets.
  • Confidence in synthesizing and presenting insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience with Excel modeling and data visualization for executive reporting.
  • Strong ownership mindset with a drive to improve processes and results.
  • Collaborative and respectful teammate across global teams.
  • Demonstrates adaptability, resilience, and a learning mindset in ambiguous or evolving situations.


Education OR equivalent combination of education, training, and experience:

  • Education, training, and hands-on experience in digital marketing or campaign management with exposure to LinkedIn Ads or multi-channel campaign execution


Additional Requirements:

  • Flexibility to work across time zones, including regular communication with the team lead based in U.S. Central Standard Time (CST), and in close collaboration across global teams and stakeholders


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to manage global digital campaigns and grow within a fast-scaling marketing function.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Customer Service Technical Support
description:

Kyniska is a leading provider of innovative HR solutions, connecting talented individuals with exciting job opportunities worldwide. Our dedicated consultants collaborate with top companies globally, offering industry insights while mentoring and training candidates. Every day, we help over 200,000 professionals achieve fulfilling careers tailored to their skills and aspirations. Benefits:

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.
